ACME INSURANCE COMPANY
CLAIM DEPARTMENT - COVERAGE DETERMINATION

Claim No.: 2026-CLM-062203
Policy No.: HO-44-99012-C
Date of Loss: January 8, 2026
Date Filed: January 12, 2026

INSURED: Priya Nair
INSURER: Acme Insurance Company
ADJUSTER: S. Alvarez, Property Claims
CLAIM TYPE: Property - water damage to kitchen and adjacent living room

DESCRIPTION OF LOSS:
A supply-line failure under the kitchen sink flooded the first floor of the
insured dwelling in Madison, Wisconsin. Cabinets, flooring, and drywall were
damaged. The insured also claimed replacement of an unrelated aging dishwasher.

CLAIMED AMOUNT: $11,400.00

COVERAGE DETERMINATION: PARTIAL. Sudden and accidental water discharge is
covered. Replacement of the pre-existing dishwasher is not.

DENIAL REASONS:
- Wear-and-tear / betterment: dishwasher replacement is not caused by the
  covered water loss and is excluded as maintenance/betterment.

SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS: plumber invoice dated January 9, 2026; photos of
affected rooms; contents inventory including dishwasher.
